Protein Food

Ground Beef

About This Entry

Ground beef is fresh beef muscle trimmed and minced for burgers, meatballs, tacos, and sauces. Its fat ratio varies by grind — higher fat suits bold reds; lean grinds need acidity or sauce. One of the most searched protein foods globally and a hub for future dish entities.

Beginner Guide

Ground beef is labeled by lean-to-fat ratio (e.g. 80/20). Handle safely, cook burgers to safe internal temperature, and rest patties briefly before serving.
